sample_unit: transcripts (193 autobiographical narratives from 49 community participants; 292 audio journals from 64 psychiatric outpatients)

links.outcome: Model performance and fairness across demographic subgroups (sensitivity, precision, calibration)
links.effect: Best models showed miscalibration in specific subgroups, lower sensitivity for female speakers in the community dataset, and lower predictive precision for Black speakers in the clinical dataset.
links.quote: Despite these strengths, a multidimensional fairness audit revealed several demographic disparities: our best-performing models exhibited miscalibration in specific subgroups, lower sensitivity for female speakers in the community dataset, and lower predictive precision for Black speakers in the clinical dataset.

unlisted_practices: Running open-weight LLMs locally on workstation hardware for privacy-preserving analysis
Comparing LLM sentiment classification against lexicon-based and human rater baselines

screen.reason: Evaluates open-weight LLMs for sentiment analysis on spoken naturalistic psychiatric and community datasets, including a fairness and demographic disparity audit, but does not test a specific deployment guardrail intervention.
